# AL ARBAB TRAVEL AND TOURS — Pakistan's No.1 Travel Agency & Best Visa Consultant

> Best Travel Agency in Pakistan | IATA-Authorized | 98% Visa Approval Rate | Islamabad

## About

AL ARBAB TRAVEL AND TOURS is Pakistan's #1 IATA-accredited travel agency and visa consultancy, headquartered in Blue Area, Islamabad. With 15+ years of excellence and 20,000+ happy travelers, we are the most trusted name in Pakistan's travel industry. Our expert case officers deliver a 98% visa approval rate across 50+ countries.

## Core Services

### Visa Consultancy (98% Approval Rate)
- **Schengen Visa** — Single visa for 29 European countries. Expert documentation & embassy appointments.
- **USA Visa** — B1/B2 tourist & business visa processing, DS-160 filing, and mock interview prep.
- **UK Visa** — Standard Visitor Visa and Business Visa with end-to-end case management.
- **Canada Visa** — Tourist visa (TRV), study permits, and immigration pathway guidance.
- **Australia Visa** — Subclass 600 visitor visa processing and documentation support.
- **Tourist Visa** — Worldwide tourist visa processing for 50+ countries.
- **Business Visa** — Corporate travel visas for Gulf, Europe & beyond.
- **Student Visa** — Study abroad support for UK, USA, Canada, Australia & Europe.
- **Family Visit Visa** — Reunion and family visit visas with full documentation.

### IATA Air Ticketing
Direct access to real-time global flight inventory from 22+ partner airlines including Emirates, Qatar Airways, Turkish Airlines, Etihad Airways, PIA, Saudi Airlines, and more. Best price guarantee with instant booking confirmation.

### Umrah Packages 2026
Economy to premium Umrah packages including flights, 5-star Makkah & Madinah hotels, airport transfers, and ziyarat tours. Group and family packages available.

### Hotel Booking
International hotel reservations with guaranteed best rates from trusted global partners.

### Travel Insurance
Schengen-compliant medical and trip cancellation insurance.

### Passport Services
New passport applications, renewals, urgent processing, and overseas passport assistance.
